title: VTOL & fixed-wing aircraft
lead: Fixed-wing, QuadPlane and tiltrotor development, from V-tail, pusher and twin-motor airframes through propulsion integration, SITL, real flight tests and missions.
caption: Aircraft from my project collection. Individual builds and development stages are documented below.
stages: Design & modeling
Airframe geometry, mechanical interfaces, meshing studies and fabrication documentation.
Build & integration
Printed airframe parts, propulsion, servos, power distribution and autopilot electronics.
Configuration & simulation
ArduPilot and PX4 setup, sensor calibration, mission preparation and simulation workflows.
Testing & analysis
Bench checks, hover and transition work, flight-log review and live support during client trials.

title: Multirotor & helicopter systems
lead: FPV, cinewhoop, quadcopter and heavy-lift work across 2 to 42-inch platforms, covering propulsion, integration, calibration, tuning and missions, alongside helicopter diagnostics.
caption: Original 10-inch FPV quadcopter project photograph.
stages: Plan the platform
Component compatibility, workshop equipment, BOMs and airframe fabrication preparation.
Integrate the aircraft
Propulsion, power, flight controllers, GNSS, RC and telemetry interfaces.
Configure & diagnose
Calibration, flight modes, failsafes, estimator review and filter/PID investigations.
Test & document
Bench and flight-test support, comparative log review and documented next-test actions.

title: Ground robotics & UAV docking
lead: Complete drone-rover system development and testing, combining aerial and ground autopilots, motor control, communications, docking and failsafe behaviour.
caption: Original project photograph of a quadcopter approaching the autonomous rover docking platform.
stages: System architecture
UAV and rover wiring, actuator interfaces and isolated power paths.
Motor control
CUAV X7, ArduRover and dual VESC interface integration.
Docking & coordination
Synchronized actuators, locking/release and communication between aircraft and rover.
System testing
Integrated aircraft, rover, docking, autopilot handshakes and failsafe checks.

title: Unmanned surface vehicles
lead: USV / ASV development, from architecture and propulsion control to autopilot navigation, onboard vision and water testing.
caption: Third-party reference photograph: OceanAlpha SL40. The actual project USV is confidential. This is not a vessel I claim to have developed.
stages: System architecture
Requirements, component selection, electrical layout and subsystem interfaces.
Propulsion & control
Differential-thrust waterjets, rudder/throttle interfaces, ESCs and power distribution.
Navigation & perception
Autopilot navigation, Jetson Nano, FPV and AI detection with an A8C gimbal camera, alongside marine communications work.
Water tests & delivery
Integrated-system checks, water trials, troubleshooting and technical documentation.

title: Avionics & machine vision
lead: Companion-computer interfaces, payload video, engineering design review and vision-based landing architecture.
caption: Embedded vision and payload integration context from my project archive.
stages: Define the architecture
Camera, companion computer and flight-controller data paths.
Review the interfaces
Power, connectors, schematic/PCB routing and source-project handoff.
Specify perception
AprilTag detection, pose estimation, coordinate transforms and MAVLink integration planning.
Plan verification
Bench checks, staged acceptance criteria and technical documentation tied to the delivered scope.
